notes.title: Pleasure Party 2 Arrives on August 25th!
notes.content:
Get ready to create wild themed sex parties in exotic locations all around the world in Pleasure Party 2.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33733604/98ab3c23989d66834ceeb874dda4da9a7137871f.png[/img]

In Pleasure Party 2, Tiffany is tasked with organizing lavish, extravagantly themed orgies in exotic locations. The orgy-creating fun is bigger and better than ever, with these features:

[list]
[*] Create up to 25 custom characters to participate in your sex parties.
[*] Earn money based on the amount of pleasure generated by women AND men.
[*] Set up orgies in 9 different large, exotic themes locations like the wild-wild-west or a science fiction space-base.
[*] Place your characters into any of over 75 positions including oral and group positions, and special positions specific to each location.
[*] Add decorative and useful props and objects to your scene to enhance your orgy.
[*] Save up to 5 parties in each location, to return to the fun later.
[*] Use "Skill points" to manage each of your characters' skills, making them generate more pleasure.
[/list]

Pleasure Party 2 takes the orgy-tastic fun of the first Pleasure Party to the next level. Add it to your wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2529930/Pleasure_Party_2/

notes.title: Taking the ADULT VISUAL NOVEL to the Next Level with Angel's Awakening.
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33733604/b4b217750e1f7b31d46709b822f294d1617bead2.png[/img]

Here are a few ways that Angel's Awakening is taking the Adult Visual Novel to the next level:

[list]
[*] Full Realtime 3D. Every scene in this super-sexy story is presented in full realtime 3D, meaning you have the control to explore the area and view the action from any angle. Nothing in the game is a static render, so you have full camera control throughout the entire game.
[*] Professional voice acting. The voice acting in Angel's Awakening, like most HFT Games, is absolutely key. There is no need to read along, as every scene is fully and professionally voiced by some of the best and sexiest voices in the industry.
[*] Scene Interaction: In each steamy scene, not only do you fully control the camera, but you can also manipulate other parts of the action, like the pose, intensity and even the scene lighting and visual effects. A "nerves" system requires you to control the intensity of each scene in a way that the lead character remains comfortable and "eases in" to the hottest, steamiest action.
[/list]

Stay tuned and get Angel's Awakening on your STEAM Wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2086970/Angels_Awakening/
